LESSON: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets, part of Pillars of Iman in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how the qualities of the prophets learnt can be applied in school situation. 1. How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search for information on the qualities of prophets from digital, devices/books/resource persons and display in class,

2. narrate a story of any prophet that shows these qualities,

3. role-play situations that demonstrate values learnt from the qualities of the prophets (e.g. honesty, obedience, patience),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

1. search for information on the qualities of prophets from digital, devices/books/resource persons and display in class,
2. narrate a story of any prophet that shows these qualities,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
